summary: Stepper walks a person through a short setup one question at a time, with a track of numbered steps that fills in as they go. Each step offers a few choices, such as how much freedom the agent should have, or your own fields. Finishing shows a confirmation that sums up the picks, with a short burst of confetti.
use: When setting up an agent needs a few decisions, like how it works and what it connects to
When each question is simple enough to answer with one of a few options
When people should be able to jump back to an earlier step to change an answer
When a step needs a server check before the person can move on
features: Each step shows a title, an optional description and either `options` to pick from or your own `content`.
Continue slides the next step in from the right, and Back slides the previous one in from the left.
Completed steps on the track show a check and can be clicked to go back to them.
`onNext` runs before moving on; returning false, or a promise of false, keeps the person on the step, and Continue is disabled while it is pending.

Finish calls `onFinish` with the picks, and the done screen lists the chosen options unless you set `doneDetail`. The track is hidden there, and the screen keeps the height the steps had, with the confirmation centred in it.
Start over returns to the first step, and `bare` (the default) sits flat in a chat thread.
a11y: Options are a `radiogroup` labelled with the step title, and each option is a `radio` with `aria-checked`.
The current step on the track has `aria-current="step"`.
Completed steps on the track are focusable buttons that respond to Enter and Space.
The confetti is skipped when the user prefers reduced motion.

faq.q: How do I validate a step before the person continues?
faq.a: Pass `onNext(step, values)`. Return false, or a promise that resolves to false, to stay on the step. Continue is disabled while the promise is pending.

faq.q: Can a step have my own inputs instead of options?
faq.a: Yes. Give the step `content` with your own fields and leave out `options`. The content shows under the title.

faq.q: How are the answers given back to me?
faq.a: `values` holds the picked option index for each step, and `onFinish` receives the same array when the last step is finished. Each step starts on its `defaultOption`, or the first option.
